verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools directly to meeting data. Some tools are read-only and others take actions such as sharing meetings or creating soundbites, and an OAuth integration needs no API keys. However, the OAuth evidence is specific to ChatGPT, and the named MCP tools are action-oriented rather than explicitly search, transcript or action-item tools. missing for 10: documented MCP tools specifically for meeting search, transcript retrieval and action items; evidence of OAuth setup for Claude or generic MCP clients; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an official MCP server lets Claude or any MCP client query my meetings — search, transcripts, action items — with OAuth, no glue code

citations.quote: The Fireflies MCP Server enables AI tools to connect directly to your meeting data without switching platforms or copying transcript excerpts.
You can now connect Fireflies to ChatGPT using our OAuth integration—no API keys required.
Once connected, you can query your Fireflies data directly through ChatGPT's Deep Research feature.
